privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: All conversion, editing, repair, ripping, recording and extraction happens locally on this computer. No account is needed and files are never uploaded. The only feature that uses the network is Download, which fetches the URLs you enter. Temporary files are written next to the output with hidden names and are deleted when a job finishes, fails or is cancelled.

formats.intro: Formats ConvertHub accepts and produces. Actual support for some formats depends on the FFmpeg build and optional tools installed (see System & tools).
formats.discOutputs: Any video or audio output format

notes.heic: HEIC/HEIF/AVIF need ImageMagick (with libheif) or a recent FFmpeg to read, and ImageMagick to write. Lossy WebP needs FFmpeg with libwebp; otherwise WebP is saved losslessly.
notes.pdf: PDF conversion extracts text. Complex layouts, multi-column pages, scanned documents and tables may not convert perfectly. OCR is not implemented, so scanned (image-only) PDFs produce no text.
notes.gpu: GPU encoding is used only for H.264/HEVC outputs and only when a hardware encoder passed a test on this computer.
notes.lgpl: Some FFmpeg builds (LGPL) lack libx264/libmp3lame; ConvertHub then uses OS encoders when available or reports which encoder is missing.
notes.disc: Only unencrypted discs can be read. ConvertHub never bypasses DRM or copy protection (CSS, AACS, BD+).
notes.download: Only direct media links and sites listed on the Download page are supported.

download.networkNotice: This feature connects to the internet and downloads from the addresses you enter. Nothing is uploaded. Only download content you have the right to download.
download.ack: I have the right to download this content, and downloading it is allowed by the provider and applicable law.

notes.direct: Any http/https link that points directly to a video or audio file. Pages (HTML) are rejected. No logins, cookies or paywalls are bypassed.
notes.archive: Public items on archive.org via yt-dlp. Respect each item's license.
notes.wikimedia: Direct file links on upload.wikimedia.org. Respect each file's license and attribution requirements.
notes.youtube: Disabled: YouTube's Terms of Service do not permit downloading except through features YouTube provides.
notes.youku: Disabled: Youku's terms do not permit third-party downloading; content is often region-restricted.
notes.vimeo: Disabled: Vimeo permits downloads only through the owner-enabled download button on vimeo.com.
notes.drm: Never supported: these services use DRM, and ConvertHub does not bypass DRM or access controls.

recorder.permissionNotice: Your operating system controls screen capture. On macOS, allow ConvertHub under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording, then restart the app. A red banner and the window title show while recording.

reasons.wayland: Screen recording is not available on Wayland sessions yet (it needs the PipeWire screen-cast portal). Log in with an X11 session to record.

video_convert.title: Convert / compress
video_convert.desc: Convert videos to another format or device profile, and reduce file size with quality, bitrate, resolution or a target size.

video_trim.desc: Keep only part of a video. Fast mode cuts at keyframes without re-encoding; precise mode re-encodes for frame-accurate cuts.

video_split.title: Split
video_split.desc: Split a video into equal-length parts saved in a folder.

video_join.title: Join
video_join.desc: Join several videos into one, in list order. Videos are scaled to the first video's size.

video_mux.title: Mux audio
video_mux.desc: Replace a video's soundtrack with an audio file (video stream is copied without quality loss).

video_crop.title: Crop
video_crop.desc: Crop a rectangle from the video frame.

video_delogo.title: Remove logo
video_delogo.desc: Hide a logo area by filling it from the surrounding pixels, in videos you own or are authorized to edit.

video_repair.title: Repair
video_repair.desc: Best-effort recovery of damaged or truncated videos. Recovery is not always possible.

media_tags.title: Edit tags
media_tags.desc: Set title, artist, album, year and comment metadata without re-encoding.

audio_convert.title: Convert / compress
audio_convert.desc: Convert audio (or extract audio from video) with bitrate, sample-rate and channel controls.

audio_trim.title: Clip
audio_trim.desc: Keep only part of an audio file.

audio_split.title: Split
audio_split.desc: Split audio into equal-length parts saved in a folder.

audio_join.title: Join
audio_join.desc: Join several audio files one after another, in list order.

audio_mix.title: Mix
audio_mix.desc: Mix several audio files together so they play at the same time.

audio_repair.title: Repair
audio_repair.desc: Best-effort recovery of damaged audio files by decoding what is readable.

audio_tags.title: Edit tags
audio_tags.desc: Set title, artist, album, year and comment metadata without re-encoding.

image_convert.title: Convert / resize
image_convert.desc: Convert pictures (including WebP and HEIC where supported) and resize, rotate or flip them.

pdf_merge.title: Join PDFs
pdf_merge.desc: Merge several PDF files into one, in list order.

pdf_convert.title: PDF to text/Word/Excel/HTML
pdf_convert.desc: Convert PDFs to TXT, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX or HTML/HTM.

pdf_images.title: Extract images

hints.preset: Profiles set the format, codec and maximum resolution for a device.
hints.accel: Auto uses a verified GPU encoder when possible and falls back to CPU.
hints.crf: 23 is a good default. Ignored when a bitrate or target size is set.
hints.videoBitrate: Leave empty to use quality (CRF) mode.
hints.targetSize: Calculates the bitrate needed to reach this size (approximate).
hints.endOptional: Leave empty to keep everything until the end. Formats: 90, 1:30, 00:01:30.5
hints.precise: Fast mode is instant but cuts on the nearest keyframe.
hints.heic: HEIC and AVIF output need ImageMagick.
hints.percent: Used only when width and height are empty. Aspect ratio is always kept.
hints.keepMetadata: Requires ExifTool. By default metadata such as GPS location is removed.

notices.join: Different sizes are letterboxed to the first video's size and the frame rate is normalized to 30 fps.
notices.crop: Use the 'i' button on a file to see its resolution. The rectangle must fit inside the frame.
notices.delogo: Only use this on videos you own or are authorized to edit. Do not remove ownership marks or watermarks from other people's content.
notices.repair: Repair is best-effort. Badly damaged files (for example MP4 files missing their index) may not be recoverable, and ConvertHub will tell you when recovery fails.
notices.mix: All inputs are mixed at equal volume; the result lasts as long as the longest input.
notices.pdf: Complex layouts, scanned documents and tables may not convert perfectly. OCR is not included. DOC and XLS output need LibreOffice; DOCX uses LibreOffice when installed, otherwise text-only output.
notices.disc: Requires an optical drive (or a copied disc folder) and permission to read it. Only unencrypted discs are supported: ConvertHub never bypasses DRM or copy protection. Only copy discs you are authorized to copy.
notices.cd: Requires an optical drive. macOS: choose the mounted audio CD. Linux: needs cdparanoia. Windows: not supported yet.
notices.archive: Files are extracted into a new folder. Unsafe paths (for example '../') are rejected, links are not created, and very large or suspicious archives are stopped. Password-protected archives are not supported.
